output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It does not check if the total supply exceeds the maximum supply, allowing the owner to mint unlimited tokens.
The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It does not check if the balanceOf[_to] + _value is a safe operation, allowing attackers to overflow the balanceOf[_to] and steal funds.
